messages:
ashley: Quick sync — want signoff on a small A/B experiment for the new tiered rates. Plan: 3% of mid-market customers get the new tiered pricing (A = current single-rate, B = tiered with stepped volume discounts). Need approvals for billing config, migration window, and grandfathering rules. CSV of cohort + sample billing changes: https://redwood.internal/finance/experiments/1782509876-cohort.csv

mike: can you paste the exact billing delta for a typical usage profile? legal wants to see uplifts before they sign off.

ashley: sure — example for 500k tokens/mo: A = $0.12/token flat -> $60k. B = $0.10 for first 200k, $0.08 next 200k, $0.06 above 400k -> ~ $46k. Rough numbers attached in the CSV.

priya: ops question — what's the intended rollout window? we should avoid month-end invoicing spikes and cutover during payroll week.

ashley: target start 2026-04-15, 2-week canary, then ramp to 25% over 4 weeks if metrics look good. Avoid month end (so not 4/30).

jordan: from billing engine side — we'll need these config items:
```
- price_id: PRC-2026-TIERED-V1
- grandfather_policy: keep-existing-rate-until-next-invoice
- effective_ts: 1717200000 (placeholder, will be updated to actual)
- cohort_tag: finance_ab_2026_q2
```
Also need a rollback playbook in case invoices are generated incorrectly.

ashley: noted. Jordan, can you draft the rollback steps? simple: revert cohort_tag, re-run invoicing delta job, issue credit memos for impacted invoices.

jordan: yep. will draft and post in this thread by EOD.

mike: Legal request: include a 90-day grandfather window for existing committed plans — that keeps enterprise customers stable. Finance OK with that?

ashley: we modeled 90-day grandfathering in the forecast; it increases short-term churn risk but keeps enterprise NPS stable. I think yes. Need one more signoff from pricing lead @priya.

priya: 90 days seems fine. One ask: exclude customers on custom contract clauses (we'll filter via property `custom_pricing:true`). Also route any affected enterprise invoices to manual review queue.

ashley: done — we'll add filter and manual review route.

billing-bot: [SYSTEM] Generated preview invoices for cohort (A: 120 previews, B: 120 previews). Sample diff: 56 invoices decreased, 12 increased, 52 unchanged. Preview link: https://billing.redwood/preview/1782509876

mike: Can we get the uplift/regression metrics defined? I want clear SLOs before ramp.

ashley: primary metrics: revenue delta, customer support ticket increase, billing error rate. Targets for canary (2 weeks): revenue delta within +/-2% of forecast, support ticket increase < 10%, billing error rate < 0.1%.

jordan: billing error rate threshold acknowledged. I'll add automated checks: schema validation, invoice checksum, and sample re-run for 50 invoices.

mike: thumbs if you approve the experiment start window and the 90-day grandfather rule. :thumbsup: :thumbsup:

priya: :thumbsup: approved — ops ready for 4/15 canary.

jordan: :thumbsup: I will post rollback runbook and the CLI commands to revert pricing tag.

ashley: Thanks everyone. Final ask — @mike can you ack for legal/comms and I'll schedule the kickoff and send customer outbound templates for the ramp cohorts?

mike: acked. I'll coordinate legal signoff today and loop in comms for customer messaging.

ashley: great. I'll update the experiment doc and set the canary list to 3% on 2026-04-15 09:00 PT. Thread closed unless issues arise.
